query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_jobs!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "succeeded_jobs!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "failed_jobs!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "canceled_jobs!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' AND source_bytes IS NOT NULL AND output_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN source_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "total_source_bytes!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' AND source_bytes IS NOT NULL AND output_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN output_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "total_output_bytes!: i64" FROM jobs
